from.place: proof, first sentence: the coherent module G is M~ for a finitely generated graded module M over S=k[x_0,x_1]

title: Coherent modules on projective space come from finitely generated graded modules
statement: Let $k$ be a field, $S=k[x_0,x_1]$ with its standard grading, and $P=\operatorname{Proj}S$ as in [def-sc-p1-standard]. For every coherent [pqf-def-coherent] $\mathcal O_P$-module $\mathcal G$, there is a finitely generated $\mathbf Z$-graded $S$-module $M$ and an isomorphism $\widetilde M\cong\mathcal G$, where $\widetilde M$ is the $\mathcal O_P$-module associated to $M$ [def-weil-pbc-proj-twisting-sheaf], whose sections on $D_+(f)$ are the degree-zero part of the localization $M_f$ for homogeneous $f$ of positive degree.
